node.name: ticket_priority
node.description: Assign a priority to the incoming support ticket.

conditions.a: Critical: service unusable for many users or data loss
conditions.b: Normal: a problem affecting one user, with a workaround
conditions.c: Low: a question or a cosmetic issue
